title: [Epic] One-way sync-in beside federation: external data becomes ordinary objects with a provenance marker, read-only by default, write-back only through declared actions (ruled A, 2026-11-09)
body:
coordinator#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbaUTJVFuEz81NDUrnw

[Epic] One-way sync-in beside federation — epic parent of the 2026-11-09 decision card (ruled A).

Ruled: 6731568115 · letter A · 2026-11-09T03:32Z — amended in the same thread 2026-11-09T03:33Z: pipelines and transforms are not built, warehouses and ETL vendors are partners; 2026-11-09T03:32Z 「Palantir 的核心能力我们都应该要有，不等客户需求」 — lineage and label-based access control get their own epics (linked under Related), not deferred to customer pull.

Epic parent under the #31502 A′ working mode: `tracking` + `area:data`, no pm state label, never dispatched; decisions anchor in the children. Filing lane and table owner: `domain:server` (the coordinator's seats). Filing gate: ④ coordination parent, on the maintainer's ruling above. ⛔ Not a claim. Original decision card (triage#1, 2026-11-09T03:02Z) kept below as the record.

## 维护者速读

把「外部数据单向同步成普通对象」做成和联邦并列的正式能力：拉取源扩到联邦数据库源和数仓、分页、删除打标、来源标记与默认只读、运行记录；写回只走声明的动作，不做双向同步。管道加工交给数仓 / ETL 伙伴。开源内核。四期约 10–15 agent 天；P0 测量 0.5–1 天。

## Milestones and children

| Milestone | Child | Blocked-by | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **P0 — measurement** | #31778 run the existing pull path (rest connector + `mapping.connectorSource` + `job.pull`) end to end; evidence per gap G1–G9 | — | server · S |
| **P1 — ADR** | #31780 the ADR: pull sources (connector, federated datasource, warehouse), paging, delete policy, the `synced` bucket + provenance columns, run record, execution identity, write-back through actions, the three-way rule and the partner stance | #31778 | spec · Tier H · fable + xhigh |
| **P2 — spec keys** | (filed on the ADR's acceptance) the keys the ADR defines, `Metadata-protocol: added` | #31780 | spec |
| **P2 — engine** | (filed on the ADR's acceptance) datasource-as-source reader incl. Snowflake / BigQuery dialects; paging loop with per-batch watermark; delete marking; provenance stamping and the bucket's write guard; catalog drift on the pull path; per-run record | P2 spec | server · M–L |
| **P3 — Studio** | (filed with P2 engine) "sync in" wizard beside the virtual-object wizard, read-only rendering of synced objects, run history on the datasource page | P2 engine | ui · M |
| **P3 — guide + skills** | (filed with P2 engine) the three-way rule (federation · sync-in · connector action), the partner stance (transforms belong to the warehouse / ETL vendor), the write-back answer | P2 engine | devx / skills · S |

Rolling split: only the current and the next milestone are cards; the rest are rows here.

## Gap list the measurement confirms (read from `main` at `9e1f1f90`, 2026-11-09)

| # | Gap | Today | To add |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| G1 | pull sources | `connectorSource` accepts rest / openapi only | a federated datasource (DB, OData, warehouse) as a source |
| G2 | paging | one response per pull, by design | declared paging; per-batch watermark |
| G3 | deletes | none | mark, never hard delete |
| G4 | provenance | none on the row; `managedBy` buckets exist (ADR-0103) | a `synced` bucket + four system columns |
| G5 | read-only gate, write-back | actions + `connector_action` exist | the bucket refuses member writes, actions pass; no bidirectional sync |
| G6 | source drift | `external_catalog` for federation | reuse it on the pull path; loud refusal on a missing column |
| G7 | run record | engine-internal job rows | per-run counts, watermark, failure; shown in Studio |
| G8 | Studio entry | datasource page, draft from remote table | a sync wizard next to the virtual-object one |
| G9 | scale | `createMany` batches in the import runner | nothing new; chunked pulls under G2 |

## Done-when

A fresh environment declares, in metadata only, a rest connector instance or a federated datasource (including a warehouse), a `mapping` and a `job`; the job pulls 100,000 rows in pages into an ordinary object whose rows carry provenance columns and cannot be edited by members; a declared action writes a change back through the connector and the next pull reconciles it; a source delete is marked; a dataset, a report and the MCP `query` tool read the rows unchanged; the run is written up as a North Star run record.

## Non-goals (ruled)

Bidirectional sync and conflict merge; a Writeback-Dataset edits overlay (#27261 N3); pipelines and transforms (partners' job); reviving the protocol 17/18 `DataSyncConfig` / `ETLPipeline` vocabulary. Lineage and label-based access control are separate epics (Related).

## Risks the children inherit

- A synced object's permissions are configured locally from zero; the source's permissions do not travel. Default `private` OWD; `security-owd-unset` already warns.
- Every synced row needs an organization (ADR-0131); a pull in a multi-organization environment declares it or the boot refuses.
- Synced tables become the largest tables; retention / archive (ADR-0057 lifecycle) must hold for them.
- Vocabulary revival: the community remembers DataSync / ETLPipeline; the skills must point at `mapping` / `job`.

## Related

#27261 (federation epic, closed), ADR-0015, ADR-0062, ADR-0103, #27293 (connector auto-shelf), #31502 (epic working mode). Sibling epics filed on the same ruling: #31781 (record-level lineage), #31782 (label-based access control and purpose restriction). Analysis report: the project's Fable thread "Discuss Palantir direction (objectstack#31763)".

## Original decision card (triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U · 2026-11-09T03:02Z) — ruled A, kept as the record

triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Path: none

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make (product direction). The maintainer, in triage's session, 2026-11-09, verbatim:
- 「palentir 是联邦这一套吗」
- 「同步进来对我们是不是更简单」
- 「palentir 用的哪一种」
- 「我就是想做 palentir 开源替代方案，立决策卡」

⛔ Not a claim.

### 维护者速读（原卡）

- **一句话问题：** 你要的定位是「开源的 Palantir 替代」。Palantir 的主路是**单向同步进来**：外部数据先进平台，再建本体（对象、关系、动作），写回原系统只靠显式的「动作」。不搬数据的虚拟表只是辅路。我们现在只有联邦这一条，也就是辅路（ADR-0015：数据留在原系统，查询转发过去；Oracle、SQL Server、OData 都已做完）。缺的正是主路。
- **为什么要定：** 联邦不做跨数据源关联、不做分布式事务，权限上也有限制（依附于父对象的外部对象目前被拒绝），查询性能取决于老系统。报表、分析、AI 问数这类需要多表关联的场景，用同步进来的普通对象会简单得多，平台现有的权限、报表、流程和 AI 都能直接用。
- **选项：** A（推荐）把「单向同步进来」做成平台的正式能力，和联邦并存（1 定时/增量同步成普通对象，带来源标记，默认只读；2 处理增量、删除、表结构变化；3 写回只通过声明的「动作」；4 联邦保留；5 第一步先测量）· B 不做平台能力，只写指南 · C 暂缓。
- **范围问题：** 分诊建议这次只定「同步进来 + 来源标记 + 动作写回」这一层，管道和加工等有需要再单独立项。

### Four facets（原卡）

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
- **① Long-term soundness:** A matches the stated positioning. The ontology (objects, relations, actions, permissions, AI) works best on data the platform holds. Federation stays for the live case. One-way sync plus explicit write-back avoids the bidirectional-sync conflict problem by design.
- **② Business pull:** the maintainer names the positioning now. Federation's limits (no cross-source joins, a row cap, refused parent-controlled objects) are the gaps a Palantir-style analysis use hits first.
- **③ AI-error resistance:** synced records are ordinary objects, so every existing gate, permission check and audit applies unchanged. Write-back stays a declared action, reviewed like any action, never an implicit merge.
- **④ Startup-stage scope:** A's first step is a measurement, not a build. Pipelines, transforms and lineage graphs are out of this decision unless the maintainer pulls them in.

Related: #27261 (ontology over external systems, closed), ADR-0015 (federation), #27293 (connector auto-shelf).
